label: Mobile native
scope: Native iOS, native Android and React Native screens judged from rendered screenshots
checks: Primary purpose and next action on each screen
Navigation and wayfinding cues that are visible, such as titles, tabs and back controls
Layout, clipping and truncation at the rendered size and scale
Visible affordances: whether controls look tappable, and selected, disabled and loading states
Forms: visible labels, requirements, validation and error states that appear in the image
Empty, loading and error states that appear in the image
Apparent touch-target size and spacing, as drawn, not as physically measured
Platform convention cues that are visible, without claiming native behavior
limitations: Screenshots from a renderer are not a physical device; each image records how it was made and what that method cannot show
Gestures, animation, keyboard interaction, focus, screen reader behavior, permission flows, network behavior, performance and crashes are not established by static screenshots
Approximate renders are not genuine platform output and are excluded from evaluation unless the user approves them
A web build of a native app is mobile web evidence and says nothing about the native app
